SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT cas_number) as unique_cas, COUNT(DISTINCT lot_id) as total_lots FROM reagents;
SELECT * FROM reagents ORDER BY cas_number, lot_id;

SELECT cas_number, name, SUM(quantity) as quantity, GROUP_CONCAT(location || ',') as locations, GROUP_CONCAT(lot_id || ',') as lot_ids
FROM reagents
GROUP BY cas_number
ORDER BY cas_number;

SELECT cas_number, name, SUM(quantity) as quantity, 
       ', '.join([loc for loc in locations.split(', ') if loc]) as locations,
       ', '.join([lot for lot in lot_ids.split(', ') if lot]) as lot_ids
FROM (
    SELECT cas_number, name, SUM(quantity) as quantity, GROUP_CONCAT(location) as locations, GROUP_CONCAT(lot_id) as lot_ids
    FROM reagents
    GROUP BY cas_number
) dedup
ORDER BY cas_number;

SELECT cas_number, name, SUM(quantity) as quantity, 
       stuff(GROUP_CONCAT(location), 1, 1, '') as locations_raw,
       stuff(GROUP_CONCAT(lot_id), 1, 1, '') as lot_ids_raw
FROM (
    SELECT cas_number, name, SUM(quantity) as quantity, 
           CASE WHEN GROUP_CONCAT(location) LIKE '%,%,%' THEN replace(GROUP_CONCAT(location), ',', ', ')
                WHEN GROUP_CONCAT(location) LIKE '%,%' THEN replace(GROUP_CONCAT(location), ',', ', ')
                ELSE GROUP_CONCAT(location)
           END as locations,
           CASE WHEN GROUP_CONCAT(lot_id) LIKE '%,%,%' THEN replace(GROUP_CONCAT(lot_id), ',', ', ')
                WHEN GROUP_CONCAT(lot_id) LIKE '%,%' THEN replace(GROUP_CONCAT(lot_id), ',', ', ')
                ELSE GROUP_CONCAT(lot_id)
           END as lot_ids
    FROM reagents
    GROUP BY cas_number
) dedup
ORDER BY cas_number;
